# API

The local HTTP API of `kapto serve`, on `server.bind`:`server.port`
(`http://127.0.0.1:7700` by default). Version 1; within a version the
API only gains endpoints and fields. Errors are JSON with the cause
`code`, a `message` and a `remedy`, listed in [Error codes](error-codes.md).

Requests that change something take a JSON body, `{}` when they have
no fields, sent with `Content-Type: application/json`. While `server.bind`
is a loopback address, requests must be addressed to `localhost` or a
loopback address (`api.host_not_allowed` otherwise).

`/api/events` is a WebSocket: each text message is one `Event` as JSON,
telling when an episode starts or ends at once and the status at least
once a second. A page from another site may not open it
(`api.origin_not_allowed`).

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/episodes` | The finalised episodes in the data directory, newest first. Folders that aren't finalised, or whose summary can't be read, are left out. |
| POST | `/api/episodes/abort` | Stop recording and discard the episode: nothing of it is kept. Answers once it is deleted. |
| POST | `/api/episodes/events` | Send an event. During an episode it is recorded in it; between episodes it is only told to whoever watches. Either way every watcher is told. Its kind must be one of `/api/event-kinds`. |
| POST | `/api/episodes/start` | Start recording an episode. Answers once it is being recorded. |
| POST | `/api/episodes/stop` | Stop recording. Answers once the episode is finalised, and listed. |
| GET | `/api/episodes/{id}` | One finalised episode in full: its streams' counts, files, buffers, how quickly it reached the disk, and the wall clock while it was recorded. |
| GET | `/api/episodes/{id}/cameras/{camera}/frames` | When each frame of one of a finalised episode's cameras was received, read from its recording by the recording's indexes: frame `n` is the `n`-th. Needs no replay made. |
| GET | `/api/episodes/{id}/cameras/{camera}/frames/{n}` | Frame `n` of one of a finalised episode's cameras, as a picture the browser draws: a compressed one as recorded, a raw one encoded as JPEG. |
| GET | `/api/episodes/{id}/events` | What happened in one finalised episode: its events, in the order its recording holds them, and the stretches it began but never ended. Before the worker has read them, `read` is `false` and there are none. |
| GET | `/api/episodes/{id}/qa` | What the quality checks found on one finalised episode: whether it was accepted, the settings it was checked with, and each check's result. Before the worker has checked it, `accepted` is `null` and there are no results. |
| GET | `/api/episodes/{id}/replay` | Where one finalised episode's replay is: not made, queued, being made, ready with what it lacks, or failed with why. It asks for nothing: `POST` does. |
| POST | `/api/episodes/{id}/replay` | Ask for one finalised episode's replay, its replay view to watch it again in the web UI. The worker makes it once, at low priority and not while an episode is recorded: asking again while it is queued, being made or made changes nothing; one that failed, or has since left the replay cache, is made again. Answers where it is, `202` until it is ready. |
| GET | `/api/episodes/{id}/replay/meshes/{n}` | One of the meshes of the robot a finalised episode was recorded with, as plain triangles, from its replay: the binary form `docs/reference/viewer-scene.md` specifies. |
| GET | `/api/episodes/{id}/replay/opening` | What a finalised episode's replay shows, once `/api/episodes/{id}/replay` says it is ready: its span, and the links and values its stretches give, in their order, as the live stream's opening message names them for the live view. |
| GET | `/api/episodes/{id}/replay/scene` | The robot a finalised episode was recorded with, as `/api/robot/scene` gives the one loaded now, once `/api/episodes/{id}/replay` says its replay is ready: from the robot description its recording carries, so a replay shows that robot whatever its package is now. Meshes are numbered, each at `/api/episodes/{id}/replay/meshes/{n}`. |
| GET | `/api/episodes/{id}/replay/window` | A stretch of a finalised episode's replay, once `/api/episodes/{id}/replay` says it is ready: the robot's newest pose and each value's minimum and maximum in each of `points` equal parts of it, read from the replay view at the coarsest step that still has that many. In the binary form the viewer stream answers a look back with (`KVHI`, the question's number 0), its span the episode's. Reading it counts as opening the replay. |
| GET | `/api/episodes/{id}/statistics` | One finalised episode's statistics, worked out with its quality checks: its duration, each stream's rate and loss, each joint's position, speed, acceleration, jerk and effort (count, extremes, mean and percentiles), each gripper's cycles. Before the worker has checked it, `computed_utc_ns` is `null` and there are none. |
| GET | `/api/episodes/{id}/uploads` | One episode's uploads, where every object of it went, and whether it is still stored here. |
| POST | `/api/episodes/{id}/uploads/retry` | Tries an episode's failed uploads again now, without waiting for `upload.retry_failed_after`. |
| GET | `/api/event-kinds` | The kinds of events that may be sent: the vocabulary file's, or the defaults without it, then each task's subtasks, and what is wrong with the file. Read again on each request. |
| GET | `/api/events` | Events as they happen, over a WebSocket. Each message is one `Event` as JSON. Connections from another site's web page are refused. |
| PUT | `/api/layout` | Save a layout as the default for the robot package Kapto runs, read by every browser: written to `layouts/<package id>.toml` in the configuration folder, checked as `layout.toml` is. Answers with it as `/api/robot` now gives it, each panel with what the package lacks. |
| DELETE | `/api/layout` | Remove the default layout saved for the robot package Kapto runs: the live view is arranged by the package's own layout again, or the one made from it. Answers with it. |
| POST | `/api/layout/check` | What a layout lacks: the layout as the live view draws it, each panel with what the robot's streams lack of it, by the rules every layout is held to. For one the operator keeps in their browser; nothing is saved. |
| POST | `/api/preflight` | Run pre-flight again: watch the streams for `capture.preflight_window` and test the disk, then answer with each check's result. A run already going is waited for rather than started again. Only between episodes: its test file would compete with a recording's writes. |
| GET | `/api/processes` | Kapto's processes, the server first: whether each runs, since when, how often it was started again, and its CPU, memory and threads. Answers even while the capture process doesn't. |
| GET | `/api/profiles` | The profiles saved in the configuration folder, each marked available if it records the robot package Kapto runs, and what is wrong with any that can't be read. Read again on each request. |
| GET | `/api/robot` | The robot and its streams as Kapto runs them: each joint with its limits and the decoded value that drives it, each stream with its input, rate and decoded fields, and problems that don't stop Kapto. |
| GET | `/api/robot/meshes/{n}` | One of the scene's meshes as plain triangles, read from its file: the binary form `docs/reference/viewer-scene.md` specifies. |
| GET | `/api/robot/scene` | The robot as the web UI draws it: each link, in the order its poses are sent as the robot moves, with its visual shapes, their colours and where they sit. Meshes are numbered, each at `/api/robot/meshes/{n}`. |
| GET | `/api/settings` | The settings Kapto runs with, each with its value and where it came from. They are read when serve starts. |
| GET | `/api/status` | What Kapto is doing: the episode being recorded, each stream's counts, and where the live view's stream is. |
| GET | `/api/storage` | How much room the data directory has, and how much the episodes in it take, including the one being recorded. |
| GET | `/api/tasks` | The tasks saved in the configuration folder, and what is wrong with any that can't be read. Read again on each request. |
| GET | `/api/uploads` | Where uploads are: each destination's counts and every upload going or failed. |
| POST | `/api/uploads/destinations/{name}/test` | Tests a destination as an upload would use it, as `kapto upload check` does: a small probe object written under its prefix, read back and removed. |
| GET | `/api/version` | The versions of Kapto and of this API. The web UI checks it when it loads. |

The full description, with every field: [openapi.json](openapi.json)
(OpenAPI 3.1). Changes that could break a client within the version are
found with `cargo xtask api-diff`.
